releaseNotes.zh: 助手提问可直接选答案，常用操作一点即开始；购买食材支持手写、拍照和相册，小票识别后确认清单再入库。优化弹窗键盘布局和页面按钮排列。Android AI 沿用现有邀请码；覆盖安装保留本地数据。
releaseNotes.en: Select suggested Agent answers and start common actions directly. Purchase intake supports typing, camera and photo library, with list confirmation before stocking. Improved keyboard-aware popups and page actions. Android AI retains existing invitation access; install over the existing app to keep local data.
